rules.statement: The repository is the installation specification; running containers and manually modified hosts are not the source of truth.
rules.title: Repository is the installation specification
rules.why: Prevents runtime or host drift from becoming an implicit configuration authority.

rules.statement: When developing or installing Linux workloads under WSL, use the WSL Linux filesystem rather than `/mnt/c`; native Windows and native Linux tools use their own appropriate host filesystems.
rules.title: Keep WSL development inside its Linux filesystem
rules.why: Avoids WSL filesystem performance and permission problems without incorrectly imposing WSL paths on the other supported execution modes.

rules.title: Keep versions documentation and tests aligned
rules.why: Keeps declared versions, human guidance and validation in sync.

rules.title: Run release check before committing
rules.why: Provides the project-defined pre-commit validation step.

rules.statement: Secrets must not be committed, copied into images or stored in Compose files.
rules.title: Keep secrets out of Git images and Compose
rules.why: Keeps credentials out of durable repository history and built artifacts.

rules.statement: Design and document AI Workstation for native Windows, Linux under WSL and native Linux using platform-specific adapters where needed. Keep public code, menu/CLI text, default examples and documentation in English regardless of the conversation language. Personal hostnames, usernames, domains, provider preferences and password-manager choices belong in private operator configuration, not product assumptions.
rules.title: Keep shipped product behavior general and English-language
rules.why: A reusable workstation must remain understandable and portable across owners, operating systems and future hardware; distinguish intended compatibility from actually validated platform support.

rules.statement: Prefer concise menus that preserve readable action results, redisplay choices on request, offer numbered selection of already known objects and briefly distinguish terms such as original credentials versus derived hashes. Keep details in linked guidance and test representative user journeys on each relevant operating system.
rules.title: Make operator workflows discoverable with little memorization
rules.why: Users should be able to return weeks later without recalling identifiers or internal commands; these are practical UX preferences, not a requirement to build another TUI or a ban on direct CLI commands.

topics.condition: When reporting a vulnerability or checking the project security-reporting procedure, read the security document.
topics.title: Security reporting resource

topics.condition: When diagnosing installation, WSL access, permissions, Docker-session, elevation or recovery problems, read the troubleshooting guide.
topics.title: Troubleshooting guide

topics.condition: When recreating or auditing the original public-repository setup from the tested prototype, read the repository setup guide.
topics.title: Public repository creation procedure
